en: Colorized historic postcard view of a European city square with a tall brick clock tower (town hall) on the left and a row of gabled houses lining a broad street or market square with trees and a fountain. In the background stands a massive brick Gothic church with a large central tower and multiple slender spires. The caption at the bottom reads "Danzig. Langenmarkt und Rathhaus." and printing information appears vertically along the left edge. The number 365 is handwritten in red in the upper right corner.
